status.en: 12 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 50% fewer than the week before, most of them in Baghdad, Kirkuk and Erbil.
status.nb: 12 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 50 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Baghdad, Kirkuk og Erbil.

summary.en: Iranian drones struck a Komala base in Erbil province and an explosion hit the outskirts of Erbil, targeting Iranian Kurdish opposition groups. A blast injured five at a Popular Mobilization Forces ammunition depot in Iraq, and a scrap collector was shot dead near a PMF site in Baghdad. Turkish foreign minister praised Iraqi premier's vision for bilateral ties in Baghdad. The conflict has seen continued attacks on Iranian-linked opposition and PMF facilities, while diplomatic engagement persists, with 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Iranske droner rammet en Komala-base i Erbil-provinsen, og en eksplosjon traff utkanten av Erbil, rettet mot iranske kurdiske opposisjonsgrupper. Et sprengningsangrep såret fem på et ammunisjonsdepot til Folkebevegelsens styrker (PMF) i Irak, og en skrapesamler ble skutt og drept nær en PMF-lokasjon i Bagdad. Irans utenriksminister roste Iraks statsminister for hans visjon om bilaterale bånd i Bagdad. Konflikten har fortsatt angrep på iransk-tilknyttede opposisjonsgrupper og PMF-anlegg, mens diplomatisk engasjement vedvarer, med 396 dødsfall knyttet til kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
